title: Union health ministry adds all vaccines, cancer drugs to schedule H2 for strict tracking & QR codes
summary: The health ministry has expanded mandatory QR-code tracking under Schedule H2 to cover all vaccines, antibiotics, cancer drugs and narcotics, widening a system that earlier applied only to top-selling brands.
